title: Single-flicker online SSVEP BCI dataset
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing a spatial navigation task using a single-flicker steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface. Participants were presented with a 15 Hz visual stimulus and instructed to navigate in four directions (north, east, west, south) based on visual feedback. The dataset includes 2 sessions per subject with 32-channel EEG data acquired at 512 Hz using BioSemi ActiveTwo hardware, and represents an online BCI application with within-subject cross-validation.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 12 healthy participants (5 male, 7 female; mean age 23.5 years) using a 32-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system with sintered Ag/AgCl electrodes in a biosemi32 montage. Sampling rate was 512 Hz with CMS/DRL reference and 50 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a spatial navigation task with single-flicker visual stimulation at 15 Hz, with trial intervals of 0.0-3.5 seconds. Signal processing employed canonical correlation analysis (CCA) for feature extraction and linear discriminant analysis (LDA) for classification with bandpass filtering at 1.0-80.0 Hz.
